verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Workers integrating with an organization's identity provider (SSO, SAML, or OIDC) to protect internal apps, deployments, or agents. The closest items are adjacent. The marketing line about built-in "Zero Trust controls" never mentions identity providers. The MCP server's OAuth runs through Cloudflare's own authorization, and scoped API tokens are a separate credential control. None of these deliver the story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
